evidence.finding: The API returns indices into original vertex buffers. Binary per-vertex locks use one for locked vertices. LockBorder applies only to topological borders; Prune can remove locked components. Neither new flag is used.
simplifyWithAttributes exposes Uint8Array or null vertex_lock.
Pinned wrapper requires Uint8Array of the original vertex count and passes it to the native API unchanged.

decision: Merge exact fan vertex locks with existing locks and preserve existing ErrorAbsolute only. Independently require full oriented fan/edge retention; the lock API is not acceptance evidence.
